summary:
The syrinx module: everything a sound source can import.

A source is an ES module that imports from "syrinx", exports `meta` and `stems`, and may
default-export a function combining them. A layer, and the mix, return their samples whole or
as a stream the host pulls one block at a time. `syrinx types` emits these declarations; point
an editor at them (a jsconfig.json, or Monaco's addExtraLib) for autocomplete and hover. Sources
are plain JavaScript -- the types are for tooling, not because anything is compiled from
TypeScript.

entries.name: Meta
entries.doc: What a source declares about itself.

members.name: name
members.doc: Display name; defaults to the file stem.

members.name: duration
members.doc: Length in seconds. Required.

members.name: channels
members.doc: 1 (default) or 2. A mono return is duplicated when this is 2.

members.name: sampleRate
members.doc: Preferred sample rate; the compiler may override it. Default 48000.

members.name: seed
members.doc: Passed to every stem and to the mix as `ctx.seed`. Default 0.

members.name: loop
members.doc: Declared seamless loop. Passed through to consumers.

members.name: api
members.doc: Contract version the source was written against, 2 or 3; compile fails on anything else.

entries.name: Context
entries.doc: What every layer and the mix are given.

members.name: sr
members.doc: Sample rate in Hz.

members.name: frames
members.doc: Number of frames to produce: round(duration * sr).

members.name: duration
members.doc: Seconds, as declared.

members.name: seed
members.doc: meta.seed, the same for every layer. Derive a voice's own with `hash(ctx.seed, "kick")`.

members.name: channels
members.doc: meta.channels.

entries.name: StemContext
entries.doc: What a layer is given: the context, plus which layer it is.

members.name: stem
members.doc: This layer's name, as declared in `stems`.

entries.name: MixContext
entries.doc: What the default export is given: the context, plus the rendered layers.

members.name: stems
members.doc:
Each layer by name, as `channels` planes of `frames` samples. Reading one makes the mix
whole-buffer; a mix stream never reads it and gets its layers' blocks as its third argument.

entries.name: Output
entries.signature: export type Output = Float32Array | number[] | [Float32Array | number[], Float32Array | number[]]
entries.doc: What a layer or the mix returns: mono samples, or [left, right].

entries.name: Stream
entries.signature: export type Stream = (offset: number, frames: number) => Output
entries.doc:
A streaming layer: called once per block of BLOCK_FRAMES, in order from offset 0 (the last
block is shorter), returning exactly `frames` samples per plane. State kept in the closure
persists between blocks.

entries.name: MixStream
entries.signature: export type MixStream = (offset: number, frames: number, stems: Record<string, Float32Array[]>) => Output
entries.doc: A streaming mix: `stems[name]` is that layer's block as `channels` planes of `frames` samples.

entries.name: Stems
entries.signature: export type Stems = Record<string, (ctx: StemContext) => Output | Stream>
entries.doc: A source's layers, by name. Names match /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$/ and keep their order.

entries.name: Source
entries.doc: The shape of a source module.

entries.name: BLOCK_FRAMES
entries.doc: Frames per block of a stream: a constant of the standard (4096).

entries.name: clamp
entries.signature: export function clamp(x: number, lo: number, hi: number): number

entries.name: lerp
entries.signature: export function lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number

entries.name: db
entries.doc: Decibels to linear gain.

entries.name: mtof
entries.doc: MIDI note number to Hz.

entries.name: fold
entries.doc: Wavefolder: reflects anything outside [-1, 1] back in.

entries.name: hash
entries.doc: FNV-1a over the arguments, as a seed: `new Noise(hash(ctx.seed, "kick"))`.

entries.name: Random
entries.doc: Seeded PRNG (mulberry32). The only randomness a source may use.

members.name: range
members.doc: [lo, hi)

members.name: int
members.doc: Integer in [lo, hi)

entries.name: Phasor
entries.doc: Phase accumulator in [0, 1).

members.name: next
members.doc: Advance one sample at `freq` Hz; returns the phase before advancing.

entries.name: Shape
entries.signature: export type Shape = (phase: number, width: number) => number

entries.name: Osc
entries.doc: Naive (aliasing) oscillators. Fine for most SFX; see BlepOsc for cleaner saws and squares.

members.name: constructor
members.signature: constructor(sr: number, shape: Shape, phase?: number)

members.name: pulse
members.signature: pulse(sr: number, width?: number, phase?: number): Osc

members.name: shapes
members.signature: shapes: { sine: Shape; saw: Shape; square: Shape; tri: Shape; pulse: Shape }

entries.name: BlepOsc
entries.doc: Band-limited saw and square via PolyBLEP.

entries.name: Noise
entries.doc: Seeded noise. One instance per independent noise source.

members.name: white
members.doc: Uniform white in [-1, 1).

members.name: pink
members.doc: Pink (-3 dB/oct), roughly [-1, 1].

members.name: brown
members.doc: Brown (-6 dB/oct).

entries.name: Envelope
entries.doc: An envelope is a function of time in seconds.

members.name: ad
members.doc: Linear attack, exponential decay to silence.

members.name: adsr
members.signature: adsr(attack: number, decay: number, sustain: number, release: number, gate: number): Envelope
members.doc: Linear attack, exponential decay to sustain, hold until `gate`, exponential release.

members.name: exp
members.doc: exp(-t / tau)

members.name: line
members.signature: line(from: number, to: number, duration: number): Envelope
members.doc: Straight line from `from` to `to` over `duration`, clamped.

members.name: sweep
members.signature: sweep(from: number, to: number, duration: number): Envelope
members.doc: Exponential sweep from `from` to `to` over `duration` (both > 0), clamped.

members.name: gate
members.doc: 1 until `duration`, then linear fade to 0 over `fade`.

members.name: points
members.doc: Piecewise-linear through [[t0, v0], [t1, v1], ...] with ascending times.

entries.name: OnePole
entries.doc: One-pole low/high-pass, 6 dB/oct. Stateful: one instance per signal.

entries.name: Biquad
entries.doc: RBJ cookbook biquad. `set` is cheap enough to call per sample for modulation.

members.name: lowpass
members.signature: lowpass(sr: number, freq: number, q?: number): Biquad

members.name: highpass
members.signature: highpass(sr: number, freq: number, q?: number): Biquad

members.name: bandpass
members.signature: bandpass(sr: number, freq: number, q?: number): Biquad

members.name: notch
members.signature: notch(sr: number, freq: number, q?: number): Biquad

members.name: peak
members.signature: peak(sr: number, freq: number, q?: number, gainDb?: number): Biquad

members.name: set
members.signature: set(type: BiquadType, freq: number, q?: number, gainDb?: number): this

entries.name: Svf
entries.doc: Chamberlin state-variable filter. `process` returns the lowpass; `.band` / `.high` hold the others.

entries.name: Delay
entries.doc: Circular delay line with linear-interpolated reads.

members.name: read
members.doc: Read `seconds` back from the write head.

members.name: process
members.doc: write then read.

entries.name: Comb
entries.doc: Feedback comb with one-pole damping in the loop.

members.name: constructor
members.signature: constructor(sr: number, seconds: number, feedback?: number, damp?: number)

members.name: constructor
members.signature: constructor(sr: number, seconds: number, gain?: number)

entries.name: Reverb
entries.doc: Small Schroeder reverb: 4 combs into 2 allpasses.

members.name: constructor
members.signature: constructor(sr: number, options?: { size?: number; damp?: number; feedback?: number })

entries.name: Processor
entries.doc: Anything with a per-sample `process`.

entries.name: render
entries.signature: export function render(ctx: Context, fn: (t: number, i: number) => number): Float32Array
entries.doc: Run `fn(t, i)` once per frame and collect the result.

entries.name: stream
entries.signature: export function stream(ctx: Context, fn: (t: number, i: number) => number): Stream
entries.doc: render(), one block at a time: a stream that is bit-identical to `render(ctx, fn)` over the same frames.

entries.name: mix
entries.doc: Sum buffers sample-wise; the result is as long as the longest.

entries.name: gain
entries.signature: export function gain(buffer: ArrayLike<number>, g: number): Float32Array

entries.name: normalize
entries.signature: export function normalize(buffer: ArrayLike<number>, peak?: number): Float32Array
entries.doc: Scale so the absolute peak hits `peak` (default -1 dBFS). Silence is left alone. Refuses inside a stream's block: use a limiter or a fixed gain.

entries.name: fade
entries.signature: export function fade(ctx: Context, buffer: ArrayLike<number>, fadeIn: number, fadeOut: number): Float32Array
entries.doc: Linear fade-in over `fadeIn` seconds and fade-out over `fadeOut` seconds. Refuses inside a stream's block: shape the level from the absolute time.

entries.name: pan
entries.signature: export function pan(buffer: ArrayLike<number>, position?: number): [Float32Array, Float32Array]
entries.doc: Constant-power pan; position in [-1, 1].

entries.name: place
entries.signature: export function place(ctx: Context, buffer: ArrayLike<number>, at: number): Float32Array
entries.doc: Place `buffer` into a new ctx.frames-long buffer starting at `at` seconds. Refuses inside a stream's block: copy into the block from `round(at * sr) - offset`.

entries.name: filter
entries.signature: export function filter(buffer: ArrayLike<number>, processor: Processor): Float32Array
entries.doc: Apply a per-sample processor over a buffer.
